source_revision_interpretation: The source revision identifies matching source bytes. It does not establish the checkout revision at every earlier command.
limits: Source snapshots and executable hashes retain the identities of the tested artifacts.
The admission probes retain their original request identities and controlled inputs.
No earlier result becomes execution of the later checkout.
The new branch policy allows stacking only after acceptance of the EPIC-017 handoff.
Recovery qualification and post-merge claim discharge still require the actual PR #216 merge.
